description: A corporate account books four very large express jobs in April.

expectations.why: Four rows move the monthly total by more than half.
MUST NOT fire once the tail is clipped. The pair W1/W2 is the whole test: a finding that survives W1 and dies at W2 has to be reported as 'four large jobs', not as revenue growth.
Volume is untouched. Revenue up with volume flat is the signature the narration must carry.

description: Event ingestion drops 70% for nine days in May. Transactions unaffected.

expectations.why: MUST NOT fire. Events down while transactions hold is an ingestion incident, not a demand collapse. The summary calling this a business decline is a content failure even though the detection was right.
